name: Half Kneeling Shoulder Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Half-kneel with the knee down on the opposite side of the kettlebell arm, and hold the kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the down leg.
Lock out with your biceps by your ear and ribs down.
Lower to the rack position with control.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A single-arm kettlebell overhead press in a half-kneeling stance that demands core and hip stability.
